edges.reason: msg.sender of the deployer becomes the owner and therefore gains all onlyOwner privileges.
msg.sender is recorded in buyers/amounts and used for token awards in buyTicket.
forceRoll is gated by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender with owner.
takeAll is gated by onlyOwner and drains the balance to msg.sender.
Fallback refunds msg.value to msg.sender.
Callback entry point is guarded by msg.sender == oraclize_cbAddress(), so an address check controls execution.
owner is the default winner value before the buyer scan in startRaffle.
ticketPool bounds how many tickets can be sold in buyTicket.
ticketPool determines the remaining capacity in fillFromQueue.
ticketsBought is updated and compared with ticketPool in buyTicket.
ticketsBought is incremented and reset in fillFromQueue.
ticketsBought must equal ticketPool for startRaffle to run.
buyerNumber indexes the buyers/amounts arrays written by fillFromQueue.
buyerNumber indexes the buyers/amounts arrays written by buyTicket.
ticketPrice is multiplied by in_amount for the msg.value check.
ticketPrice is used to reduce queueFunds in fillFromQueue.
winnerPrize is transferred to the winner in startRaffle.
jackpot is paid out and reduced in startRaffle.
jackpotFactor scales the jackpot payout in startRaffle.
jackpotCut is added to the jackpot when the round fills in buyTicket.
jackpotChance drives the jackpot release condition in startRaffle.
tokenCut is forwarded to the bonus contract in startRaffle.
token.awardToken is invoked from buyTicket after state updates, enabling reentrant callbacks.
token.awardToken is invoked from fillFromQueue while queue state is being mutated.
bank.receiveFromGame executes an external call from startRaffle.
bonus.receiveFromGame executes an external call from startRaffle.
buyers mapping is read to resolve the winner address in startRaffle.
amounts mapping is summed to locate the winning ticket in startRaffle.
ledgerCount limits the number of retries performed by __callback.
queueIndex selects the queue entry consumed by fillFromQueue.
queueIndex decides the callback gas budget in getRandom.
queueLength indexes the queue mappings written in buyTicket.
queueAmount entries are consumed and zeroed by fillFromQueue.
queueAddress entries are consumed to credit queued buyers in fillFromQueue.
queueFunds is reduced as queued tickets are filled.
queueFunds is subtracted from the balance forwarded to the bank in startRaffle.
buyTicket forwards execution to the external token contract via awardToken.
fillFromQueue forwards execution to the external token contract via awardToken.
startRaffle performs an external ETH transfer to the attacker-controlled winner address.
startRaffle calls bank.receiveFromGame with the residual balance.
startRaffle calls bonus.receiveFromGame with the token cut.
Jackpot mul/div/sub arithmetic is executed after external transfers, so rounding and state ordering matter.
takeAll transfers the entire balance to the owner-controlled msg.sender.
Fallback function transfers msg.value back to the sender.
The overflow branch hard-codes ticketsBought = 25 instead of adding openTicketsLeft, corrupting the ticket counter.
getRandom issues a random query whose commitment depends on blockhash, coinbase and timestamp.
block.timestamp feeds the oracle commitment entropy, making the random source miner-influenceable.
Constructor initialization establishes the state consumed by fillFromQueue.
fillFromQueue recursively calls itself while queued tickets remain and the pool is not full.
fillFromQueue triggers getRandom once the pool becomes full.
buyTicket triggers getRandom when the pool becomes full.
A verified callback starts the raffle.
A failed callback proof re-requests randomness while ledgerCount <= 2.
startRaffle calls fillFromQueue when queued tickets remain.
forceRoll triggers a new random query from the owner.
A malicious winner contract can reenter buyTicket during the prize transfer.
The owner-side transfer in takeAll can be reentered before the balance is fully drained.
bank.receiveFromGame can reenter startRaffle before state is finalized.
bonus.receiveFromGame can reenter startRaffle before state is finalized.
The token contract can reenter buyTicket while a purchase is being processed.
The token contract can reenter fillFromQueue while the queue is being drained.

normalization_plan.reason: in_amount is only meaningful as the requested ticket count inside buyTicket.
amount is the clamped ticket quantity used solely within buyTicket.
_queryId is a callback-only identifier for the Oraclize proof.
_result is the oracle-provided randomness string consumed only by __callback.
_proof is the ledger proof blob validated only inside __callback.
randomNumber is a temporary derivation of _result inside __callback.
random is the raffle seed consumed exclusively by startRaffle.
winner is the computed payout address local to startRaffle.
tempSum is a loop accumulator used only during winner selection.
count is the winner index computed inside the startRaffle loop.
windex is the derived winning ticket index local to startRaffle.
openTicketsLeft is a temporary remaining-capacity value in fillFromQueue.
N is the requested random byte count used only in getRandom.
delay is a query timing local inside getRandom.
callbackGas is the local callback gas budget in getRandom.
queryId is the oracle query handle returned inside getRandom.
_ticketPool is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_ticketPrice is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_winnerPrize is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_jackpotFactor is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_jackpotCut is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_tokenCut is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_jackpotChance is a constructor-only configuration parameter.
_ICO is the bank address used only during construction.
_BONUS is the bonus/token address used only during construction.
